_readme: Servers listed here appear under 'Community' on the Slate multiplayer screen. Each entry needs a name and an address (host or host:port); description is optional and shown as a tooltip. Players can join directly or add an entry to their own list. The example entry is not shown (example.com addresses never are); replace it with real ones.
